meta.title: Berlin Football Screen Board
meta.disclaimer: A venue-level listing is not confirmation of a specific fixture. Check the venue's official programme on match day.

regular.label: Named by venue
regular.description: The official venue page names this competition. It still does not confirm every fixture.

selected.label: Selected matches
selected.description: The venue says it shows selected matches or a broader competition group. Check the exact fixture.

current-programme.label: In current programme
current-programme.description: A dated official programme included this competition when checked. Recheck the individual match.

ask-first.label: Ask first
ask-first.description: The competition is named, but the exact broadcast list varies or is published elsewhere.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.description: No current official evidence for this competition was recorded in this check.

venues.name: Kilkenny Irish Pub
venues.reservationPolicy: Online reservation available. The venue says its programme can change.
facts: The official sports page names four of the five competitions on this board.
The venue advertises several large screens.
cautions: Confirm the exact fixture with the venue, even when the competition is named.

champions-league.evidence: The official sports programme names the Champions League among the competitions shown.

premier-league.evidence: The official sports programme names the English Premier League among the competitions shown.

la-liga.evidence: La Liga was not named in the verified official programme text.

bundesliga.evidence: The official sports programme names the Bundesliga among the competitions shown.

europa-league.evidence: The official sports programme names the Europa League among the competitions shown.

venues.name: FC Magnet Bar
venues.reservationPolicy: The venue says reservations are not possible during matches.
facts: The official calendar has carried Champions League, international matches and simultaneous broadcasts.

venues.name: Tante Käthe Fußballkneipe
venues.reservationPolicy: Reservation information was not verified in this check.

The venue describes itself as non-smoking.

venues.name: Blarney Irish Pub
venues.station: U Mehringdamm or U Platz der Luftbrücke
venues.reservationPolicy: Reservation information was not verified in this check.
facts: The official sports page publishes a dated match list.
The current list included Bundesliga, second Bundesliga, Premier League, DFB Cup and League Cup fixtures.
cautions: Use the dated programme for the exact match. A league appearing once does not mean every fixture is shown.

champions-league.evidence: No Champions League fixture was present in the verified dated programme.

premier-league.evidence: The official dated programme contained multiple Premier League fixtures when checked.

la-liga.evidence: No La Liga fixture was present in the verified dated programme.

bundesliga.evidence: The official dated programme contained Bundesliga fixtures when checked.

europa-league.evidence: No Europa League fixture was present in the verified dated programme.

venues.name: Country Cheers
venues.reservationPolicy: A EUR 12 minimum spend per person applies to football matches.
facts: The venue advertises televisions plus two large screens and can switch between different events.
It shows the Bundesliga conference or the top match of the day.
Smoking is allowed, entry is 18+, and the venue does not offer normal food.
cautions: Other competitions may be available on request, but that is not treated as verified coverage.

champions-league.evidence: The official page did not name the Champions League in the verified text.

premier-league.evidence: The official page did not name the Premier League in the verified text.

la-liga.evidence: The official page did not name La Liga in the verified text.

bundesliga.evidence: The official page says it shows every Bundesliga matchday as a conference or the top match.

europa-league.evidence: The official page did not name the Europa League in the verified text.

venues.name: Belushi's Berlin Alexanderplatz
venues.reservationPolicy: Online booking is available from the official venue page.
facts: The venue advertises 13 HD televisions and a huge screen.
The venue says staff speak English and food is served until 22:00.
cautions: Only competitions explicitly verified on the official venue page receive a positive matrix status.

champions-league.evidence: The official Berlin Alexanderplatz page explicitly names the Champions League.

premier-league.evidence: The official Berlin Alexanderplatz page explicitly names the Premier League.
